title: Simplify the hierarchical automatic facet name
body:
Right now it's a counter and it will break if you reorder the hierarchical widgets between them at some point.

We can:
- use the first attribute from the hierarchical facet instantiation (thus url will always contain: `categories.lvl0: dsadas > fsafsa` (not so good because lying)
- concat all attributes (ugly and long)
- $YOUR_IDEA?

Change the way we store the state of a hierarchical facet (dunno what's feasible)
